title: Evaluation of a layered circuit tail
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let a circuit tail consist of a list of gates followed by a remaining tail, choose an AND or OR gate, and assign a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube to each of the $m$ inputs. Evaluating the whole tail as a function is the same as evaluating the remaining tail with the dual gate on the functions obtained by applying the chosen gate to each listed input set.
hypotheses_covered: the layer is a list of finite input sets indexed by the $m$ inputs
the remaining tail has one input for each listed gate
the gate is either AND or OR
each of the $m$ inputs is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
